title: sxsw-2026-travel-expenses-scratchpad
content:
Notes to self - SXSW Austin 2026 (conference + booth)

Itinerary (personal copy)
- Flight outbound: SFO -> AUS, United UA1986, dep 2026-03-11 07:10, arr 2026-03-11 12:20. Checked bag (23kg) on same record.
- Flight return: AUS -> SFO, United UA1992, dep 2026-03-15 17:45, arr 2026-03-15 19:55.
- Hotel: The Driskill (group rate), confirmation 887-DRK-21. Check-in 2026-03-11, check-out 2026-03-15.
- Car/ground: plan to use rideshares (Uber/Lyft). Keep digital receipts.

Conference logistics
- Badge pickup: Austin Convention Center, South Hall A; badge pickup opens 2026-03-11 at 09:00. Aim to pick up during lunch to avoid lines.
- Booth setup: March 11 afternoon (2pm-6pm). AV contact: LoneStar AV, Chris Ramos, +1-512-555-0123, chris@lonestar-av.com. Confirm HDMI + power strip and 2x 110V outlets.
- Booth shipping: crate arrives 3/10 to loading dock. Shipping vendor: FastShip Events (invoice contact: invoicing@fastshipevents.com). Save invoice for reimbursement (use expense code TRV-BOOTH-2026).
- Meetings: several customer meetings scheduled. See calendar invite list; attach receipts for any meals labeled as "customer-meal".

Expense reminders (finance rules + my checklist)
- Keep all receipts (digital or paper). Scan paper receipts immediately with Expensify app.
- Card: use corporate card for booth vendor invoices, hotel, flights. Use personal card only for meals/taxis if corporate not accepted; will submit for reimbursement.
- Foreign/Local currency: everything is USD (domestic), but tip lines sometimes split - ensure full receipt.
- Per diem for meals? Confirm with Finance: previous conferences had $75/day cap for domestic events (ask @Maya). Note: client dinners pre-approved up to $150/person (book under project code PROJ-SXSW).
- Expense codes: TRV-CONF-2026, TRV-BOOTH-2026, SAMPLES-SHIPPING-2026. Use cost center 4200 (Events) per Confluence notes.
- Timeline: submit all expenses within 30 days of trip end. Attach vendor invoices, booking confirmations, boarding passes.

Vendor contacts (quick)
- Hotel front desk: The Driskill, +1-512-555-0100 (ask for group reservations desk).
- AV: Chris Ramos, LoneStar AV, +1-512-555-0123, chris@lonestar-av.com (confirm on-site tech at 1pm on 3/11).
- Shipping/Invoicing: FastShip Events, billing: invoicing@fastshipevents.com, phone +1-512-555-0188 (use for crate pickup receipts).
- Local logistics (Redwood partner): Austin Events Co., contact Sarah Nguyen, sarah@austinevents.co, +1-512-555-0147.

Packing / admin items to remember
- Business cards (x2 boxes) + booth swag (sticker packs + postcards).
- Power strip + USB hub + spare HDMI cable.
- Laptop + dongles + backup battery.
- Printed agendas and meeting list (keep one set at booth).

To-do (before leaving)
- [ ] Confirm AV requirements with Chris (email by 2026-03-01).
- [ ] Upload booth shipping invoice to expenses and tag TRV-BOOTH-2026.
- [ ] Finalize meeting slots and share updated calendar with Maya and Liam.
- [ ] Pre-approve any attendee dinners > $100 with Finance (Maya to help).
- [ ] Set OOO for 3/11-3/15 and add on-call contact (Liam).

Receipts & reimbursement tips
- Attach boarding passes (screenshot) to expense item.
- For meals where attendees paid separately, include attendee list + company (for client meals).
- For shared Ubers/taxis: submit the whole ride and note split in comments.
- If we pay a vendor by ACH and they provide a .pdf invoice, include the invoice and the confirmation of payment from the bank.

Open questions / follow-ups
- Do we need a local business license to hand out swag in certain areas of the venue? (Ask Sarah)
- Confirm whether hotel incidental charges (mini-bar) are reimbursable - likely not.
- Are parking fees covered if we use an Uber rental? (probably no)

Quick reference codes (for expense system)
- Event / travel: TRV-CONF-2026
- Booth & shipping: TRV-BOOTH-2026
- Swag / marketing: MKT-SWAG-2026

Useful links (copy into expense entry)
- Booth plan (confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/SXSW+Booth+Plan
- Expense submit: https://expenses.redwood.ai/submit?event=SXSW2026
- Calendar (shared): https://calendar.google.com/redwood/sxsw-2026

Notes to self (informal)
- If flight delayed, call UA priority line and escalate via corporate travel desk (card notes).
- Keep one clean shirt for customer dinners.
- Bring a few extra chargers to give to engineers who forget theirs - good small talk.

Last-minute checklist (day before travel)
- Confirm boarding passes & TSA PreCheck.
- Photo of all receipts stored in phone folder "SXSW-2026-RECEIPTS".
- Slack a note to #events-team with final arrival times.

-- end of scratchpad --

Unresolved: ask Finance (Maya) about exact meal per diem cap and whether booth shipping is billed to corporate card or vendor invoice needs PO.

(If I forget something, search this doc for "TRV-" tags)
